title: S&P Global Adds Kfir Godrich to its Board of Directors

body_markdown:
- *Mr. Godrich brings extensive experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, data, and AI*
- *Appointment effective January 1, 2027; Mr. Godrich will serve on the Board's Audit Committee*


NEW YORK


, Nov. 17, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[S&P Global](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824123-1&h=3325121686&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.spglobal.com%2F&a=S%26P+Global) (NYSE: SPGI) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved the appointment of Kfir Godrich to the Board, effective January 1, 2027.


Mr. Godrich most recently served as Chief Innovation Officer, and previously as Global Head of Technology, at BlackRock, Inc., where he led enterprise technology, cybersecurity, data, and AI with responsibility for a significant share of the firm's technology operations and served on its Global Operating Committee. He led the development of BlackRock's enterprise data platform and AI Labs, embedded AI across business workflows, and was instrumental in migrating the Aladdin platform to the cloud.


Earlier in his career, Mr. Godrich held senior roles at Hewlett-Packard focused on cloud, data center and enterprise technology strategy. Prior to that, he held leadership roles in mission-critical infrastructure, telecommunications, energy and data center technology at EYP Mission Critical Facilities and eNetPower.


"Kfir is an experienced and innovative technology and business leader who operates at the leading edge of AI, cybersecurity and quantum computing," said **Martina L. Cheung, President and CEO, S&P Global** . "As we see the convergence between financial and physical markets, he also brings unique strengths to the S&P Global Board with his background in digital infrastructure and energy."


"We are very pleased to welcome Kfir to the S&P Global Board," said **Ian P. Livingston, Non-Executive Chairman of the Board, S&P Global** . "His deep experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity and large-scale transformation will strengthen the Board's expertise and bring valuable perspective as we support Martina and her team in delivering long-term value for our customers and shareholders."


"It is an honor to join the Board of S&P Global," said **Kfir Godrich** . "Technology continues to create significant new opportunities for companies and their clients, and I look forward to bringing my experience and perspective to the Board as S&P Global continues to innovate and grow."


Mr. Godrich will serve on the Board's Audit Committee.
